> Hệ thống **Delivery Workflow** cho project **Secomm Launchpad**.
> Workflow Engine hướng dẫn AI qua delivery thực tế: đang ở stage nào, function nào được phép/yêu cầu,
> khi nào cần research / review / validation / evidence / memory, và next state hợp lệ là gì.

## Workflow cho project này

- **Role (primary):** `developer`
- **Project-type:** `greenfield` (new-build)
- **Mode:** `A` (full ceremony — new-build, architecture impact, >16h)
- **Trạng thái:** `delivery_ready` — project vừa initialized xong, **chưa có delivery task active**.

→ Chi tiết: `workflow-profile.md`.

## State sequence (Developer role — 10 states)

```
1 Task Created → 2 Ready For Analysis → 3 Researching → 4 Planning → 5 Implementing
→ 6 Self Review → 7 Waiting Review → [8 Fix Review] → 9 Ready For QC → 10 Done
```

Work **không được skip ahead** — transition invalid bị block (ví dụ Implementing → Done là INVALID;
phải qua Self Review → Waiting Review → QC).

## Greenfield project-type (project-level sequence)

```
1 Init ✓ → 2 Architecture → 3 Bootstrap ✓ → 4 Spec → 5 Implement → 6 Test → 7 Deploy → 8 Hypercare
```

States 1 (Init) + 3 (Bootstrap) đã xong (toolkit generated). Project hiện ở giữa state 2/4 —
chờ task delivery đầu tiên (architecture decisions + feature spec).

## Cách AI dùng workflow

1. **Session start** → đọc `.ai/runtime/workflow/CURRENT_WORKFLOW_STATE.md` → biết đang ở đâu.
2. **Trước function** → check "Applicable Workflow States" của function → validate allowed.
3. **Trước transition** → check exit criteria → validate → evidence → memory → advance.
4. **Khi transition** → append `.ai/runtime/workflow/WORKFLOW_HISTORY.md`.

## Mode A ceremony

| State | Mode A |
|---|---|
| Researching | Mandatory (trừ bypass: trivial/config/format) |
| Planning | Full plan reviewed bởi TL |
| Self Review | Full AI pre-review |
| Waiting Review | TL review PR |
| Ready For QC | QC full test |

## Decision gates (Navigator — pause ở level ≥ 2)

| Transition | Decision gate | Level |
|---|---|---|
| Planning → Implementing | `plan-approval` (TL) | 2 |
| Self Review → Waiting Review | pre-review PASS (auto if PASS) | 0 |
| Waiting Review → Ready For QC | `code-approval` (TL) | 2 |
| Ready For QC → Done | `qc-signoff` (PM/TL) | 2 |
| Architecture → Bootstrap (greenfield) | `architecture-approval` (SA) | 2/3 |
| Spec → Implement (greenfield) | `spec-approval` (SA/TL) | 2 |
| Deploy → Hypercare (greenfield) | `release-gate` (production launch) | 3 |
